summary: Two controllers (GasAnalysisController: 5 modes, 7 transitions; MovementController: 8 modes, 23 transitions) over the Vehicle's sensors and operations; all 81 requirements traced, none unimplemented. 12 choices the requirements do not settle are listed below.

issues.title: Constant values are not given by the requirements
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 say thr, lv, evadeTime, stuckPeriod, stuckDist and outPeriod are configured at start-up but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: Chosen: THR = 5.0, LV = 1.0, EVADE_TIME = 1, STUCK_PERIOD = 2, STUCK_DIST = 2.0, OUT_PERIOD = 1. All are whole numbers, so the model's rounding of fractional constants does not change any guard. Replace them with the deployment's configuration if it is known.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs has a stated initial value (empty). sts, ins, anl, a, l, d0, d1 and the evasion clock have none.
issues.fix_directive: Chosen: sts = noGas, ins = 0.0, anl = Front, a = Front, l = front, d0 = d1 = 0.0, evasionStart = 0. Each is overwritten before it is read on every path (sts in Analysis entry, ins in GasDetected entry, a by turn, l by obstacle, d0/d1/evasionStart on the way into Avoiding/AvoidingAgain).

issues.title: intensity and location on an empty reading; direction of each sensor position
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 and CD-Fn3 have the precondition that the reading is non-empty, and CD-Fn3 uses angle(x) without saying which direction each position has.
issues.fix_directive: For an empty reading intensity returns 0.0 and location returns Front (the controller never calls them with one: GasDetected is reached only after analysis found a target sample). Positions 1..4 map to Left, Right, Back, Front (the Angle declaration order) and the mapping repeats for longer readings. On a tie, the first position with the peak intensity wins.

issues.title: What 'indicates the target chemical' means, and which chemical is the target
issues.raw: CD-Fn1: analysis returns noGas if no reading indicates the target chemical. The target's identity is not given; CD-Fn2/CD-Fn3 take the peak over all samples without restricting to the target.
issues.fix_directive: A sample indicates the target if its chemical equals the target and its intensity is positive. The target is a constructor parameter of GasSensorArray. intensity and location take the peak over every sample, as CD-Fn2/CD-Fn3 state. If they should consider target samples only, change GasSensorArray.strongest.

issues.title: Intensity is a real; the GasSensor record is named GasSample
issues.raw: CD-DM5 makes Intensity a totally ordered type and CD-Const1 makes thr an Intensity. CD-DM6 names the record GasSensor.
issues.fix_directive: Intensity is a double (real), so thr is a numeric constant and goreq compares two reals. The record is GasSample(Chem c, real i): a type whose name contains 'sensor' is read as a sensor service by the extractor. Chem is a record with a nat id (an opaque identity with equality only).

issues.title: move, randomWalk, shortRandomWalk and changeDirection are actuator methods
issues.raw: CD-OP1..4 are of type 'operation'. They actuate the Vehicle and take arguments, which the compute() operation-class shape (no arguments, assignments only) cannot express.
issues.fix_directive: They are methods of VehicleActuator, so the model sees calls to operations. changeDirection implements CD-OP4's steering in Java (left -> Right, right -> Left, front -> Back, at LV) by calling move. The model keeps it as an operation call without that body. Halting is move(HALT_VELOCITY = 0.0, Front).

issues.title: The odometer is a sensor method, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 types the odometer as an event; it is sampled inside the Avoiding entry and on the TryingAgain -> AvoidingAgain transition, not used as a trigger.
issues.fix_directive: OdometerSensor.odometer() is read in those actions (d0 = odometer, d1 = odometer) and becomes a sensor variable in the model.

issues.title: turn, stop and resume are declared as both OutputEvent and InputEvent records
issues.raw: CD-ARCH2: the two reasoning subsystems communicate only via turn, stop and resume. Gas analysis sends them; movement receives them.
issues.fix_directive: The gas-analysis controller sends OutputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume through CommandLink.apply; the movement controller receives InputEvent.Turn/Stop/Resume. The names are identical so each pair becomes one shared event. ChemicalDetector.cycle forwards them at run time. If the model shows them as unconnected events, this pairing is the cause.

issues.title: Waiting's during action randomWalk() runs on entry to Waiting
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR1: the during action of Waiting is randomWalk(). The Java profile has no during actions, and an unguarded, event-free branch would diverge.
issues.fix_directive: randomWalk() is called on every transition into Waiting (the six resume transitions, CD-MV-Beh3/8/12/15/20/23, which themselves have no action). An unbounded random walk continues until a later move supersedes it, so this matches the during action, except at start-up: the initial entry into Waiting (CD-MV-Beh1, no action) issues no randomWalk.

issues.title: Final states are terminal modes Concluded and Halted
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6: gas analysis concludes; CD-MV-Beh9: Found -> final. CD-DC1 asks for one transition per behavioural requirement.
issues.fix_directive: Gas analysis goes to the terminal mode Concluded (emitting stop). Movement has an unconditional Found -> Halted transition, and Halted is terminal. NoGas -> Reading and Found -> Halted are written as mode blocks without an inner if (no trigger, no guard); neither is part of a cycle of internal steps.

issues.title: Entry actions inlined; evasion clock reset on the transitions into Avoiding
issues.raw: CD-MV-Clock1/Beh7/Beh17: the evasion timing restarts on each fresh evasion. CD-MV-FR6 gives AvoidingAgain no entry action and no turn/obstacle transitions.
issues.fix_directive: Each branch into Avoiding resets evasionStart = timer.now() and then performs the Avoiding entry (d0 = odometer, changeDirection(l), pause(EVADE_TIME)). d1 is recorded on the TryingAgain -> AvoidingAgain transition. AvoidingAgain is transient: its guards makingProgress and !makingProgress are complementary. Obstacles in Waiting, Avoiding, AvoidingAgain and GettingOut are not handled, as the requirements give no transition for them.

issues.title: Wiring classes not named by the requirements
issues.raw: ChemicalDetector (composition and one control cycle), CommandLink (gas analysis -> movement signals) and Clock (logical time with now/tick/pause) are not requirements of their own.
issues.fix_directive: They realise CD-ARCH1/CD-ARCH2 and CD-MV-Clock1 and are traced to them. Neither controller depends on ChemicalDetector.
